caption: Sunlight shines through a stained-glass window, and coloured patches of light lie across the church floor.

sa.check: Sunlight shines through a stained-glass window.
Coloured patches of light lie across the church floor.
Each patch has the colour of the glass it came through.
The patches lie on the side away from the window.

pc.expect: Each patch has the colour of the glass it came through.
pc.fail: A patch is a colour not in the window; or all patches are white; or the patches swap colours.

pc.expect: The patches lie on the floor away from the window and would fade if a cloud covered the sun.
pc.fail: They lie on the window side; or on the ceiling; or they stay bright with the sun plainly gone.

pc.expect: The patches together form the window's pattern, stretched by the angle.
pc.fail: They form a different pattern; or are round blobs; or one patch splits.

pc.expect: The patches do not move with the sun steady.
pc.fail: They drift across the floor; or flicker; or swing round.
A second window's patches appear; or the window vanishes; or a patch becomes solid.

pc.expect: The window and the floor stay the same.
pc.fail: The glass changes pattern; or the floor changes; or the pews rearrange.
